easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Crookshank Kobolds.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying its mana cost.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Crookshank Kobolds and one other creature you control, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
